name: Archon Theron Valerius
description: An imposing, silver-haired man in his late sixties with a face etched by ritual scars and eyes that seem to stare through physical reality. He moves with the deliberate, heavy grace of a glacier.
background: Born into a long line of Wardens, Theron was raised within the walls of the Grand Anchorhold. He witnessed a catastrophic breach as a child that killed his mentor, cementing his belief in absolute orthodoxy.
personality: pragmatic to the point of cruelty
fiercely protective of the order's legacy
goals: To complete the Great Conjunction, a ritual of immense power that will permanently seal the major breaches, regardless of the collateral cost to the surrounding dreamscape.
